title: Pickup Hold and Collection Rule for Ridgeline Orders & Delivery Pickup Orders
content:
**Clause.** A Ridgeline Orders & Delivery pickup order is held until its pickup deadline date, which is the ready date plus the program's hold days, and may be extended once by the program's extension days on request before it lapses. It may be collected at the service desk, at the curb where the program offers curbside pickup, or from a locker where the program offers a store pickup locker, by the customer or, where the program allows a person named by the customer to collect, by the alternate person named on the order, with photo ID where the program requires it.

## The hold, counted

- The pickup deadline date is the last day the order is held. It is found by adding the program's hold days, in calendar days, to the ready date shown on the order.
- One extension is available, on request, before the hold lapses; it moves the pickup deadline date later by the program's extension days. An extension recorded on the order shows the new last day of the hold.
- Only one extension is available on an order; a hold already extended once is not extended again.

**Worked dates (hypothetical figures, not any program's terms).** Assume a hold of 6 days and an extension of 2 days. An order that became ready on 2026-08-03 has a pickup deadline date of 2026-08-09. If the extension is requested on or before 2026-08-09, while the hold has not lapsed, the new pickup deadline date is 2026-08-11.

## Collection points and collectors

| Question | Answer under the clause |
|---|---|
| Where may the order be collected? | At the service desk; also at the curb where the program offers curbside pickup; also from a locker where the program offers a store pickup locker |
| Who may collect? | The customer; also the alternate person named on the order where the program allows a named person to collect |
| Is photo ID needed? | Yes, where the program requires photo ID at pickup |
